translation: Zhang Jiegu said: Du means to be the capital; it is the capital and guide of the yang vessels. Ren means to conceive; it is the nourishment of the yin vessels. Wang Haizang said: Yin Qiao and Yang Qiao both arise in the heel, being qi that combines and connects; the Ren and Du vessels both arise below Zhongji, being the water groove that joins them.
